description: Execution-level NL2SQL benchmark. Each case pairs a question with a hand-written gold SQL query. The translator-generated SQL is executed against the embedded graph and its result rows are compared (order-independent) against the gold query's rows. Disease-specific cases (e.g. '高血压用什么药') require entity-aware filtering; the older aggregate-only template would fail them, so this benchmark proves end-to-end SQL correctness, not just intent labels.

cases.question: 高血压用什么药
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS drug FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'treated_by' AND s.name = '高血压' ORDER BY drug ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 糖尿病用什么药
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS drug FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'treated_by' AND s.name = '糖尿病' ORDER BY drug ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 高血压有哪些症状
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS symptom FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'has_symptom' AND s.name = '高血压' ORDER BY symptom ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 糖尿病有哪些症状
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS symptom FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'has_symptom' AND s.name = '糖尿病' ORDER BY symptom ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 冠心病做什么检查
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS examination FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'diagnosed_by' AND s.name = '冠心病' ORDER BY examination ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 高血压怎么治疗
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS treatment FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'recommended_treatment' AND s.name = '高血压' ORDER BY treatment ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 哪些疾病关联最多症状
cases.gold_sql: SELECT n.name AS disease, COUNT(*) AS symptom_count FROM edges e JOIN nodes n ON e.source = n.id WHERE e.predicate = 'has_symptom' AND n.type = 'Disease' GROUP BY n.name ORDER BY symptom_count DESC, disease ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 图谱中有哪些关系类型
cases.gold_sql: SELECT predicate, COUNT(*) AS edge_count FROM edges GROUP BY predicate ORDER BY edge_count DESC, predicate ASC

cases.question: 列出所有疾病
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name AS disease, mention_count FROM nodes WHERE type = 'Disease' ORDER BY mention_count DESC, disease ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 各类型实体的分布
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM nodes GROUP BY type ORDER BY node_count DESC, type ASC

cases.question: 提及次数最多的实体
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, type, mention_count FROM nodes ORDER BY mention_count DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 哪些疾病的并发症最多
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.name AS disease, t.name AS complication FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'complication_of' ORDER BY disease ASC, complication ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 图谱里连接度最高的枢纽节点
cases.gold_sql: SELECT n.name, n.type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edges e WHERE e.source = n.id OR e.target = n.id) AS degree FROM nodes n ORDER BY degree DESC, n.name ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 哪些疾病会出现头晕症状
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS disease FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'has_symptom' AND s.type = 'Disease' AND t.type = 'Symptom' AND t.name = '头晕' ORDER BY disease ASC LIMIT 20
